currentParagraphText: “I fail to understand the source of your stubbornness. Are there guarantees you remain unsatisfied with? Is there truly nothing that could make you compromise? The value of the Truesoul is high, yes, but only to us. There must be something you value that we can offer,” the Lodestar Matron said, sounding more confused than before.
